# 1.38.0-beta.4

Fourth beta of 1.38.0: a tidier session panel, a new compaction screen and fixes.

## Session panel

- Click a file in the Files card to show it in Explorer with the file selected.
- Agents are listed by model name only, and empty Files and Agents cards no longer carry explanatory lines.
- Context categories show their share of the used context as a percentage.
- The panel and the context badge in the composer are hidden in a new or empty chat. While the panel is visible, the badge stays hidden because the panel already shows the same data.
- The "scroll to top" button and the zoom badge now sit to the left of the panel instead of underneath it.

## Context compaction

- "Compact the context" opens a compaction screen in place of the panel cards: a before and after scale that follows your choices and shows the share that will be freed, "Compact the first message", how many recent messages stay untouched (10 by default), the model for this run and your own instructions.
- With "Compact the first message" turned off, the first question and its answer stay word for word.
- Every compacted message is marked with an icon next to its price or time. Click it to restore the originals and remove the compaction.
- Long conversations are summarized in parts, so the beginning is no longer dropped when the text exceeds the size limit.
- Compaction runs per chat: compacting one chat no longer blocks another, the "compacting" notice no longer lingers on a chat you have left, and the panel buttons work right after a compaction.
- The price of a compaction is counted even when the chat has no priced answer or the compaction fails.

## Chat and agents

- An agent's report reaches the chat model in full. Long reports were cut at 12,000 characters, which made the chat ask the agent again.
- The chat total is stored with the chat and no longer goes down when messages are deleted. The total in the composer now follows the open chat and disappears in an empty one.
- Click your avatar or name in the sidebar to open the account settings.

## Updates

- With "Beta versions" turned on, pre-releases are found even when the GitHub API refuses the request: the app reads the releases feed instead of the page of the latest stable release.
